title: 물속 3초
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad with R&B influences. A soft, breathy female vocal performs a melodic line over a minimalist arrangement. The primary accompaniment is a clean, electric piano playing jazz-influenced chords with a subtle tremolo effect. A steady, mechanical metronome-like click or woodblock sound provides a rhythmic pulse at 72 BPM in 4/4 time. The arrangement features environmental foley sounds including water droplets and a low-frequency hum. The vocal is processed with moderate plate reverb and close-mic intimacy. The key is G Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric piano with tremolo, steady woodblock click]
[foley: water dripping, low hum]

[Verse 1]
[breathy female vocals]
하루가 끝났어
욕조에 물을 받았어 들어갔어
따뜻해 천장을 봤어
수도꼭지에선 물이 한 방울씩 떨어져
냉장고가 돌아가 벽 너머 TV 소리가 들려
소리가 많더라 이 세상은

[Chorus]
고개를 뒤로 젖혔어
귀가 물에 잠겼어
소리가 사라져
전부 사라져
수도꼭지도
